# Python dependencies of the ci.yml sdk-compat job, hash-pinned (the pak
# repos' CI7 pattern). Installed with:
#   python3 -m pip install --require-hashes --only-binary :all: -r .github/ci/sdk-compat-requirements.txt
# The compat pass imports vcfcf_managementpacks.sdk_builder, whose import chain
# needs PyYAML (vcfcf_managementpacks/loader.py) and requests (via
# vcfcf_supermetrics -> vcfcf_common/client.py); the rest are requests'
# dependencies, which --require-hashes makes us pin too.
# Hashes: PyPI's published sha256 (https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json),
# read 2026-10-23, for the CPython 3.12 manylinux x86_64 and aarch64 wheels
# (the job's setup-python is 3.12) or the py3-none-any wheel. Wheels only:
# a listed sdist hash would let pip fall back to building it silently.
